Priya: Noticed a tiny but painful billing edge: SA keys minted via the "integration preview" flow are sometimes billed to the creator org rather than the project the key was attached to. Hits quotas unexpectedly. Anyone seen this pattern?
Max: Yes, I have. The preview flow mints a token for demoing and doesn't always set created_project on the key record because it treats previews as ephemeral. But those tokens get used in real calls from partners and end up being long-lived.
Deepti: The root cause sounds like two things: (1) preview mode didn't persist project metadata to avoid clutter, (2) routing still assumes that absence => use principal-derived project. For preview keys the principal often resolves to org root.
Owen: UX tradeoff: preview keys were intentionally lightweight. But we need an audit-safe and billing-safe mode. Options: persist project metadata for preview keys, or change routing precedence to prefer key.meta when present and keep fallback as-is.
Priya: I prefer persisting lightweight metadata (created_project + origin=preview) — keeps routing deterministic. But add an automatic TTL so truly ephemeral keys expire and don't show in lists.
Max: If we add origin=preview, telemetry teams can filter and exclude previews from some cost dashboards. Proposed origin enum: console|api|integration|preview.
Deepti: Implementation plan: 
1) auth: when minting preview keys, persist created_project and origin=preview (behind feature flag). Ensure TTL column is set.
2) gateway/routing: consult key.metadata.created_project first if present, then principal. No change in effective behavior for keys without created_project. Feature flag rollout.
3) billing: prefer key.created_project for attribution if present; otherwise fall back. Emit metric `billing.attribution_source_total{source="key|principal|exchange|fallback"}`.
Owen: Backfill: run a targeted job for keys with origin=preview that are currently active and used in the last 90 days. Populate created_project where we can infer it from auth_events. Mark ambiguous ones as created_project=unknown and surface in admin UI.
Priya: Dashboard + Alerts: add a Grafana panel for "preview key attribution" and an alert if `billing.attribution_source_total{source="principal",origin="preview"}` > 1% of preview traffic for 10m. That indicates previews being misattributed.
Max: UI: key list should show an orange pill "preview" and allow org admins to bulk-convert preview keys to normal (persist metadata + optionally re-issue). Also a tooltip: "Preview keys are intended for demos; converting will make them billable to the project shown."
Deepti: Security note: when persisting preview metadata, avoid exposing partner-provided freeform names. Normalize to internal ids and the limited origin enum.
Owen: Rollout steps: flag in auth for claim+persist -> emit metrics for 1% of tenants -> run backfill dry-run -> write-back in batches -> enable routing precedence (5% -> 25% -> 100%).
catalog-bot: scheduled migration task preview-key-backfill (dry-run) at 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z by Deepti
Priya: I'll open RFC and split tickets. Can we aim for first canary next Thursday?
Max: Works for infra. I'll prepare the Grafana dashboard and the alert rule.
Deepti: I'll add unit tests for TTL cleanup and the backfill dry-run. Also add a safety check: if attribution changes for a single key cause >$50 in shift, create a review ticket.
Owen: Good idea. Let's also add a short-lived debug metric `migration_run_id` during backfill so we can correlate. Remove after validation.
Priya: Thanks all  putting RFC link here when ready.
